Red Bull KM Sprint | Le Prese (130.1 km)

story: After another long fight for the breakaway, a large group of nearly 40 riders went clear. On the Mortirolo, Bardet attacked, with Eulalio countering, while Carapaz increased the pace in the GC group and briefly went clear. A front group of eight formed before the final climb, where their advantage had dropped to just 30 seconds. Bardet attacked again, but Del Toro proved strongest to take the win, strengthening his lead in the GC.
